name: IL-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Ford's large fundraising advantage over Koppie
Prediction markets price Democratic win near certain
Open seat after Danny Davis's retirement
model.rationale: This Chicago-based seat carries a +34 Democratic partisan lean, and La Shawn Ford has outraised Chad Koppie by more than ten to one while markets price a Democratic win at roughly 98%. With no competitive polling or expert ratings suggesting otherwise, the fundamentals alone make a Republican upset implausible.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or an unexpectedly well-funded late outside intervention against Ford would be the only realistic path to tightening the race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Danny Davis (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Danny Davis's retirement leaves this heavily Democratic Chicago seat open, but the district's +34 Democratic partisan lean makes the party a heavy favorite to hold it. State legislator La Shawn Ford enters as the Democratic nominee with a substantial financial edge, having raised over $720,000, while Republican Chad Koppie has raised only about $55,000 with almost no cash remaining.

Outside groups have spent roughly $2.5 million opposing Koppie, and prediction markets price a Democratic win near certainty. No general-election polls or expert ratings exist for the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, which point to a comfortable Democratic hold in the low-thirty-point range.
